stimulus.text: John Trumbull, Declaration of Independence. The painting shows five men, including Thomas Jefferson, presenting a document to John Hancock, seated at a table at the right, while a large group of men in formal dress looks on in a grand chamber. The painting was commissioned by Congress in 1817 and completed in 1818. It shows the presentation of the draft Declaration to Congress on June 28, 1776, not the signing of the Declaration.

stem: In the painting, the founders are shown as...

options.misconception: The scene is indoors, in a grand chamber, not in fields.

prisoners held by the British in a London court.
options.misconception: The men are free leaders in an American chamber, not prisoners.

rationales.C: The painting shows formally dressed men gathered in a grand chamber around the document.
rationales.A: No soldier, weapon, or battle appears in the painting.
rationales.B: The scene is indoors, not in fields around Philadelphia.
rationales.D: The men are leaders in Congress, not prisoners in London.
rationales.general:
1. The painting shows a large group of men in formal dress in a grand chamber.
2. At the center, five men present a document to Hancock at a table.
3. The men stand and sit with dignity, as leaders at work.
4. So the founders appear as dignified leaders gathered around a document.
Remember: describe what you can see in the image before judging what it means.
